itemsSent.title: ADNOC Chief Says World Has “Eroded Its Supply Buffers”

itemsSent.title: VLCC rates rising again as focus shifts toward war escalation risk
itemsSent.why: Rising VLCC freight rates driven by war escalation risks increase shipping costs, adding a risk premium to crude oil prices.

itemsSent.title: Crude oil dives to session low on Iran peace talk hopes ahead of midterms
itemsSent.why: Crude oil prices fell due to optimism surrounding potential U.S.-Iran peace talks and diplomacy easing Mideast supply disruption fears.

itemsSent.title: How Iran Just Broke the U.S. Oil Shield In Saudi Arabia Yet Again
